title: Detail Service Authorization Form
subtitle: Vehicle Detailing Service: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Detail Service Authorization Form turns vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature into a customer-facing Vehicle Detailing Service consent record. The detail service advisor itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the customer / vehicle owner's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Detail Service Authorization Form at detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point. Verify applicable Vehicle Detailing Service requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the customer / vehicle owner's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature scope or cost changes.

sections.title: Requesting party, authority, and source record
sections.guidance: For Vehicle Detailing Service, identify responsible parties, detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point, and the linked vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature source.

sections.title: Decision evidence, conditions, and limits
sections.guidance: Capture Vehicle Detailing Service facts for vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Decision evidence, expiry, and next control
sections.guidance: Resolve open Vehicle Detailing Service conditions; have detail service advisor assign the next Vehicle Detailing Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.guidance: Pause Vehicle Detailing Service when compatibility, damage, contamination, scope expectation, or final quality concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Vehicle Detailing Service proof and route unresolved vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature scope to detail service advisor.
